question: Chords AB and CD of a circle intersect externally at P. If AB = 7 cm, CD = 1 cm and PD = 5 cm, then the length of PB (in cm) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

By the **Secant-Secant Power Theorem** for external intersection:

PA × PB = PC × PD

⇒ (PB + AB) × PB = (PD + CD) × PD

⇒ (PB + 7) × PB = (5 + 1) × 5 = 30

By testing the options, if PB = 3 cm, then (3 + 7) × 3 = 10 × 3 = 30, which perfectly satisfies the equation.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 cm.**
